motto: Settlers 7: WePlay Edition - The community fixes what Ubisoft left behind.
setupIntro: Your original game stays unchanged. We prepare a separate copy and set up graphics automatically.
installInfo: About 7 GB is needed. All required components are included. No additional commands are needed.
detecting: Looking for a supported game installation…
notFound: Choose your original game folder once to continue.
found: Game found. Click Install game to prepare everything.
browseHint: Select the folder containing Base or Data\Base.
dataHint: Choose your existing WePlay storage location or a new folder with enough free space.
storagePolicy: Your existing storage location is reused. Old WePlay game files are cleaned up automatically after a successful update. The safe switch temporarily needs space for one extra copy. Saves and personal files are kept.
cleanup_required: Too many older copies could not be cleaned up. Close older games and choose Help: Remove older versions, then retry the update.
cleanup_deferred: The new game copy is ready. Some old files are still in use or could not be cleaned up safely. Close older games, then choose Help: Remove older versions.
playIntro: Choose how to start. You choose the map and match afterwards in S7.
runningInfo: You can minimise this launcher. It manages the background components until your game ends.
lanIntro: Choose this start method on every PC. WePlay connects your computers automatically, without entering IP addresses.
lanNone: No lobby found. You can create one, or refresh after your friend starts theirs.
borderlessInfo: Borderless uses the selected desktop resolution and keeps your monitor arrangement.
rendererInfo: Modern graphics includes the tested water correction and a 60 FPS limit. Availability is checked on this PC.
qualityPresetInfo: Presets set the controls below: high texture, lighting, shadow and water quality without depth of field, with game antialiasing and 16× texture filtering. Clear landscape keeps object detail at Medium; Highest object detail also raises it to High. Click Save to apply. Higher load and memory use are possible; check on this PC.
anisotropicFiltering: Sharper landscape textures (16× anisotropic filtering, Modern graphics only)
anisotropicInfo: Improves textures viewed at an angle. Adds no lighting or geometry. Turn off if artifacts appear; has no effect in compatible mode. The 60 FPS cap and water correction remain active.
simple: Simple main menu + VSync (lower CPU use)
helpIntro: Installation, graphics and network help. New versions are checked automatically when the launcher starts.
cleanupConfirm: Remove unchanged game files from older prepared versions? Saved games and modified files will be kept.
cleanupDone: Older prepared versions have been cleaned up. Personal and modified files were kept.
reportSaved: Diagnostic report saved. It contains no player identifiers, save data or network addresses.
errorTitle: The operation could not be completed
retry: Please try again after resolving the issue.
operation_failed: The operation failed. The diagnostic details are available in Help.
installation_invalid: This installation needs repair. Run Setup again or select Repair.
package_invalid: Installer files are missing or changed. Run the complete Setup again.
operation_busy: Another operation is already using this installation.
renderer_unsupported: Modern graphics was not confirmed on this PC. Choose Automatic or Compatible graphics.
destination_invalid: Choose a separate location outside your original game and the installer files.
preferences_invalid: Some saved settings need to be reset. Repair the installation.
quality_ini_invalid: The game's settings file has unexpected or duplicate graphics entries. It was not overwritten.
quality_ini_changed: Game settings changed during startup. Close other copies and try again.
lobby_gone: The selected lobby is no longer available. Refresh the list.
version_mismatch: This lobby uses another version. Install the same RC on every PC.
network_changed: The selected network changed. Refresh the list.
ownership_invalid: The files could not be safely identified as belonging to this installation. Nothing else was removed.
managed_copy_busy: This game copy still has an active game or LAN component. Close it before continuing.
source_invalid: This folder is not an unmodified supported History Edition installation.
source_steam_unsupported: This Steam build is identified. This preparation package does not include its matching Steam adapter yet. Use a newer package with Steam support or the supported Ubisoft Connect installation. Your Steam files were not changed.
game_failed: The game ended with an error. You can try Compatible graphics in Help.
cancelled: The operation was cancelled. Your previous working copy was kept.
probe_invalid: The graphics check could not be read. Try the check again.
update_required: Finish the update before starting the game.
memory_low: Windows reports too little additional memory capacity. Close unused applications and try again.
game_running: Close all running Settlers 7 games before changing this installation.
disk_low: There is not enough free disk space for a separate game copy.
lan_failed: LAN preparation failed. Check the selected home network and allow private LAN access using the button in this window.
memory_warning: Memory is running low or monitoring failed. Please save and restart the game. The launcher does not terminate your match.
preferences_reset: Some incompatible saved settings were reset. The original files were kept in the previous version.
closeBusy: An operation is running. Cancel it at the next safe point?
closeGame: The game is still running. The launcher will stay in the notification area.
uninstallInfo: Saved games, personal settings and modified files are kept. Please wait.
permissionDone: Private LAN access has been configured.
permissionFailed: Windows did not configure LAN access. A declined administrator prompt or managed firewall policy can prevent this. Security policies remain unchanged.
unsupportedSize: This desktop size exceeds the supported limits. Select a windowed resolution.
nameInvalid: Use a name of 1–24 UTF-8 bytes, without leading/trailing spaces or control characters.
resetConfirm: Back up the damaged installation record and start guided setup again? All existing game files and saves will be kept.
lanTitle: Play together on your home network
lanSteps:
1. Everyone starts LAN mode here.
2. One player creates a match under Multiplayer in S7; turn off “Private session”.
3. The others select that match in S7 and join it.
lanTrouble: Everyone needs the same WePlay version and the same private home network. If you cannot find each other, use “Allow private LAN access” on each PC.
firewall_remove_failed: Windows could not remove this installation’s private LAN rules. Approve its Windows prompt and retry. Game files have been kept.
lan_unreachable: A LAN group was found but is not reachable. Check private LAN access on its PC.
lan_version: Your LAN group is using a different game or patch version. Install the same WePlay RC on every PC.
lan_multiple: Several active LAN groups were found. Finish those matches before starting one shared group.
lan_full: The LAN group is full. Try again after someone leaves.
lan_changing: The LAN group is changing. Wait a moment and start again.
internetIntro: One person opens a WePlay room; friends join with their invitation. The room connects your PCs. You then create the actual match in S7.
internetDirect: Direct via your own reachable address
internetAssistedInfo: Public EasyTier nodes help WePlay connect your PCs. Game traffic travels directly when possible and uses a relay when needed. This connection does not publish your match on Discord.
internetDirectInfo: For manually configured reachable connections only: no public discovery or relays. Requires a numeric address such as udp://203.0.113.10:11010. Some routers do not allow this mode.
internetSafety: The room invitation gives access to your group: share it only with your players. The creator keeps WePlay and their PC connected while others play. Windows requests permission for the Internet connection.
internetClipboardFailed: The invitation could not be copied. Try the copy button again.
phase_internet_ready: Internet room ready. Preparing the game…
phase_internet_hosting: Your game ended. Keeping the room open for active guests…
internet_invitation_invalid: This room invitation or direct address is invalid. Guests need the complete WePlay room invitation from the creator, not a Discord link or connection code. For direct hosting, check the address you entered.
internet_network_overlap: The Internet room overlaps another active network. Create a new room or disconnect the conflicting VPN.
internet_adapter_invalid: The EasyTier adapter is missing or changed. Close this room and reconnect.
internet_status_invalid: The Internet connection could not be verified. Close this room and reconnect.
internet_address_conflict: Two peers selected the same room address. Close your connection and join again.
internet_runtime_invalid: EasyTier files are missing or changed. Update or repair WePlay.
internet_admin_required: Windows permission is needed to create the Internet adapter.
internet_disconnected: The Internet room or its creator is no longer reachable.
internet_direct_unavailable: A direct connection could not be established. Check the reachable endpoint or use public-assisted mode.
internet_connect_timeout: The Internet room did not become ready. Check the creator, connection and Windows permission.
internet_cleanup_failed: A background network component is still closing. Wait briefly before trying again.
internet_parent_invalid: The requesting launcher could not be verified. Restart WePlay.
internet_elevation_cancelled: Windows permission was declined. Your game was not started.
internet_elevation_failed: Windows could not start the Internet network helper.
internet_request_invalid: The Internet setup request could not be verified. Restart WePlay.
internet_failed: The Internet connection failed. Close the room and try again.
internet_firewall_failed: Windows could not configure or remove this room’s firewall rules.
internet_windows_required: This Internet integration requires Windows 10 or 11.
internet_channel_failed: The private invitation channel could not be established. Restart WePlay.
internet_coordinator_unreachable: The room creator is not ready or reachable. Ask them to keep WePlay running.
discordInfo: Find players, share room invitations or get help on our Discord server. The community code opens Discord; private game rooms have their own invitations.
discordRoomCopied: Invitation and instructions copied. Send the text to your players yourself, for example in a private Discord message.
discordOpenFailed: Discord could not be opened. Use invitation code j2eQgVzssc on discord.com.
discordPublish: List my own public matches on Discord when I open a room
discordConnected: Listings enabled: when you open a room, your own public S7 matches appear on Discord. Room invitations are not published.
discordNotConnected: Not linked. Private Internet play and joining work without a Discord link.
discordConnectInfo: In Discord: #🎮multiplayer → /weplay-hilfe → “Launcher verbinden”. Paste the private connection code here; it is not the room invitation. It lets WePlay list your public matches. Listings are enabled after linking; you can switch them off before starting.
discord_connection_invalid: This Discord connection code is invalid. Create a new code in Discord.
discord_connection_failed: Discord could not be connected. Check the code and the external service.
discord_not_connected: Connect WePlay through /weplay-hilfe in Discord first, or disable public listings.
discord_publish_failed: The Discord listing cannot be updated right now. Your game continues; old reports expire automatically.
discord_status_invalid: The local game status could not be verified. Unverified data will not be published.
discord_unavailable: This WePlay version does not include automatic Discord listings. Update the launcher.
discord_windows_required: Private Discord connection storage requires Windows.
updatesIntro: The launcher automatically checks for new versions when it opens. You can check again here and install an available update.
updatesPreserve: The game and launcher close for installation. Your saves, settings and private Discord connection are preserved. If game files change, WePlay prepares a new game copy at the next launch and transfers your local data.
updateAutomatic: New versions are checked automatically at startup.
updateChecking: Checking for a new WePlay version …
updateCurrent: WePlay is on the current approved version.
updateNoRelease: No signed update has been published yet.
update_unavailable: This launcher version does not support update checks yet.
update_invalid: The update information could not be verified.
update_signature_invalid: The update signature is invalid. The update will not be installed.
update_download_failed: The update service or download cannot be reached right now. You can check again later.
update_incompatible: This update is not compatible with your launcher.
update_downgrade: An older update version was rejected.
update_busy: Finish your game and other WePlay operations before updating.
update_parent_invalid: The running launcher could not be verified for updating. Restart WePlay.
update_handoff_failed: The update could not be started safely. Your existing launcher remains available.
update_changed: The available update has changed. Check for updates again.
update_disk_full: There is not enough free disk space for the update download.
update_hash_invalid: The update download is incomplete or changed. It will not be executed.
update_install_failed: Update installation failed. Check the update status and try again.
updateLastFailure: The last update did not finish: {0}
memory_commit_low: Windows reports critical memory pressure: at most 1 GiB of additional memory capacity is available. Close unused applications and try again.
memory_physical_warning: Little physical memory is currently available. Windows can page memory and the game can still start. Loading may take longer and stuttering may occur.
memory_status_failed: Windows memory measurements could not be read reliably. Please try starting again.
memory_commit_warning: Windows memory headroom is limited. The game can still start; larger maps or longer games may need more memory.
playTitle: How would you like to play?
startLocalInfo: For the campaign, skirmishes against AI and Cartographer. Opens S7 without connecting other PCs.
startLanInfo: For friends on the same home network. Everyone starts LAN mode; WePlay finds the connection automatically.
startInternetInfo: For friends in different places. One person opens a room; the others join with their invitation. Discord is optional.
internetUnavailable: This installation does not include Internet connectivity yet. Install the current WePlay version to use these start methods.
internetHostSteps:
1. Open a room and start S7 below.
2. Copy the room invitation in the launcher and send it privately to friends.
3. In S7: Multiplayer → create a match. Turn off “Private session” so your group can see it.
internetGuestSteps:
1. Paste the creator’s WePlay room invitation, not a Discord server link or Discord connection code.
2. Join the room and start S7 below.
3. In S7, open Multiplayer, select the creator’s match and join it.
internetConnectionAuto: Connection: Automatic (recommended). No server of your own is needed.
internetConnectionDirect: Connection: Direct only. The creator needs an address reachable from outside their network.
internetConnectionFromInvite: Connection settings are taken from your room invitation.
internetHostConnecting: Opening your room. Approve the Windows network prompt if requested. This does not create a match in S7 yet.
internetHostReady: Room ready. Copy the invitation for your friends. S7 is starting; you then create the match in the game.
internetHostPlaying: S7 is running. Send your friends the room invitation. Then create a match under Multiplayer in S7 (“Private session” off); your friends select it there.
internetHostWaiting: Your S7 has closed. WePlay keeps the room open while other players remain connected. It closes automatically after everyone leaves.
internetGuestConnecting: Connecting to the room in your invitation. Approve the Windows network prompt if requested. S7 will then start.
internetGuestReady: Room connected. S7 is starting. Open Multiplayer there and select the creator’s match.
internetGuestPlaying: S7 is running. Open Multiplayer, select the creator’s match and join it. The creator must open their match in the game first.
internetGuestEnding: S7 has closed. Your room connection is closing; the other players remain connected.
internetClipboardReadFailed: The clipboard cannot be read right now. Try again or paste the invitation with Ctrl+V.
discordOptionalInfo: You play through the Internet room. Discord helps you find players and list matches. The bot does not distribute room invitations; the creator sends them separately.
discordOptions: Set up / manage automatic match listings
discordSetupSteps: To list your own matches: in Discord, open /weplay-hilfe in #🎮multiplayer, select “Launcher verbinden”, then link this launcher. This is not needed for private play or joining.
discordConnectedPrivate: Match listings linked but switched off. Your matches are not listed on Discord.
discordUnavailableInfo: You can visit the community. Automatic match listings require the current WePlay version.
discordConnectionCode: Private code for linking match listings
startGuideTitle: Which start method should I use?
startGuide:
Solo: campaign, AI matches or Cartographer; does not connect other PCs.
LAN: all PCs share a home network. Everyone starts LAN mode.
Internet: one person opens a room; friends join with their room invitation. Discord is not required.
roomGuide: Room and match are two steps: the WePlay room connects your PCs. One player then creates the match under Multiplayer in S7 with “Private session” off; the others select it there. That setting alone publishes nothing on Discord.
invitationGuide: Keep these separate: the Discord server link opens the community. The Discord connection code only enables automatic match listings. The WePlay room invitation comes from the creator and connects you to their group.
graphicsModeInfo: Automatic chooses modern graphics when your PC supports it. Compatible graphics is the fallback for graphics problems. Save applies your choice to the next game start.
maintenanceGuide: Check looks for damaged or missing game files. Repair opens setup for the separate game copy. Compatible graphics saves the fallback mode; checking graphics support tests this PC again. Removing older versions frees disk space and asks first. A diagnostic report helps investigate problems.
